description: Paste a Canton/Daml/Splice ERROR MESSAGE, stack trace, or error code and get the most likely resolved fixes from CCPEDIA history: forum threads where the same error was discussed, and related GitHub issues (each with its own date). Needs a literal error string or code (e.g. TOPOLOGY_TOO_MANY_PENDING_TOPOLOGY_TRANSACTIONS, ValidatorLicense); do NOT use it for symptom descriptions with no error text (e.g. "my balance is zero"), use semantic_search for those. Canton-specific. Returns top 3 matches each from forum and github.

error_text.description: Error message, stack trace, or status code. Longer/more distinctive text returns better matches.

name: diagnose_error
